title: Music changes: Dixieland, modern jazz and rock
summary: Humphrey says modern jazz and rock draw younger audiences while the old style is unchanged.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
